## Earlier upstream evidence retained by reference

### Frozen HFT

The pinned source records the dual-XGMII pre-hardware system, protocol/session/replay closure and simulation-derived latency baseline. Its claims remain upstream claims at the pinned SHA; this integration repo does not rewrite their evidence level.

### Frozen RMIC

The pinned source records M5.4 functional regressions and U50 post-route closure for the standalone dual-flow risk core. Those results establish feasibility of the frozen core, not timing closure of the future combined HFT_RMIC top.

## Integration history notes

- The 2023 bidirectional-risk thesis was re-audited before integration. RMIC already addresses the thesis future work for hardware compensation and conflict-free multi-account throughput, but rate/outstanding/volatility/stop-loss controls remain integration-layer gaps.
- A key semantic gap was identified: frozen RMIC accounting is stock-like/long-only. TAIFEX futures integration therefore introduced separate long/short and OPEN/CLOSE semantics instead of silently interpreting SELL as inventory liquidation.
- The frozen HFT R01 packer stores 16-bit quantity, which matches the TMP R01 `uint16` quantity contract; adapter zero-extension is explicit.
- The frozen HFT report sequence owner remains the authority for committed/de-duplicated R02/R32 events. Integration accounting must never mutate from raw decoder events alone.
